row.team_price_text: Custom pricing based on company FTE count
row.evidence: Gem's help centre says team members are added automatically when they sign up with the team's domain and deprovisioned when their Gmail account is deactivated; SAML SSO is documented but no SCIM endpoint appears in the help centre or API reference.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Quote-only pricing (both packages are custom, based on FTE count; a Startup Program shows $130/mo at 1-10 FTE). No SCIM: provisioning is domain-based JIT on sign-in (Google, Microsoft or SAML, with an optional SAML role attribute), and deprovisioning is manual or follows Google account deactivation. The CRM API only lists users; the ATS API (Gem ATS customers) can also disable and enable users. The Okta OIN app named 'Gem' belongs to a different company.

plans.name: Gem All-in-One
plans.price_text: Custom pricing based on company FTE count
plans.notes: Startup Program: under 30 employees get All-in-One free for six months, then 50% off; the startup calculator shows $270 struck through and $130 per month at 1-10 FTE on yearly payment.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the help centre sitemap (1,191 URLs, none mention SCIM or provisioning apps) or in the CRM/ATS OpenAPI specs. Users join by domain sign-up or invite and are deprovisioned when their Google account is deactivated or by an admin. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Team-wide 40-character key in the X-API-Key header (ATS API also accepts it as HTTP Basic username).

capabilities.notes: CRM API only lists users; the ATS API (needs Gem ATS) can also retrieve, disable and enable users. No create, invite, update or delete endpoint.

endpoints.purpose: List users (CRM API, paged, filter by email)
Disable user (pauses sequences and reports; side-effects can't be undone)

rate_limits.text: 20 requests per second per API key, burst 500; 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: User disable/enable endpoints are in the ATS API, which requires Gem ATS to be enabled on the account.

okta.notes: Gem's SAML guide gives Okta settings for a custom SAML app. The OIN entry named 'Gem' (okta.com/integrations/gem/) is a different company (cloud threat detection), not this Gem. Provisioning false by absence.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (gem-tutorial 404). Gem's SAML guide says it applies to other IdPs.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google account status: Gem team members are automatically deprovisioned when the linked Gmail account is deactivated; users with the team's email domain auto-join on sign-up.
fallbacks.notes: Domain-matched users are added on first sign-in (Google, Microsoft or SAML); the SAML role attribute assigns the role on login.
